title: Task Status
description: Standardized task status values based on A2A TaskState enum. Indicates the current state of any AdCP operation.

enumDescriptions.submitted: Task accepted and queued for long-running execution (hours to days). Client can always poll get_task_status (legacy tasks/get) with task_id; push_notification_config is an optional notification channel for terminal completion/failure and optional progress updates.
enumDescriptions.working: Agent is actively processing the task, expect completion within 120 seconds
enumDescriptions.input-required: Task is paused and waiting for input from the user (e.g., clarification, approval)
enumDescriptions.canceled: Task was canceled by the user
enumDescriptions.failed: Task failed due to an error during execution
enumDescriptions.rejected: The agent declined the request as a structured AdCP task outcome, either before execution or after evaluating a well-formed request as defined by the task-specific schema. This is not a transport failure; A2A carries an AdCP business rejection in a completed task's DataPart.
enumDescriptions.unknown: Task is in an unknown or indeterminate state
